GAB.note: Document is about civil registry reform; no statistics from administrative records stated.
No link between civil register and ID system stated.
Only a planned digital, biometric, centralised system and a preparatory workshop; nothing procured, piloted or rolled out is stated.
Mentions data protection only as an aim; no law stated.
No enrolment count or share stated.
No operation or maintenance of an ID system stated.
No register keyed on the ID number stated.
No national ID system status stated.

facts.fact: The Interior ministry's Secretary General opened on 28 September 2026 a ten-day workshop preparing national civil registration assizes and operationalisation of the Centre national d'état civil, under the Gabon Digital programme.
